definitions.gloss: going on to higher education, advancing to the next level of schooling
definitions.explanation: Continuing to a higher level of education, such as from high school to university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進学|しんがく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：noentry⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I'm unsure whether to go on to university.

examples.japanese: {進学|しんがく}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The rate of advancement to higher education is rising year by year.

examples.japanese: {進学|しんがく}⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying for entrance exams at a cram school.

notes:
{進学|しんがく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is used as a する-verb meaning "to advance to higher education."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進学|しんがく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go on to higher education)
- {進学|しんがく}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (advancement rate)
- ⟦{進学|しんがく}{校|こう}→進学校：17212_shingakukou⟧ (college preparatory school)
- {進学|しんがく}⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧ (cram school for advancement)
- {進学|しんがく}⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧ (desire to continue education)

CONTRAST:
- {進学|しんがく}: going to higher education
- ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧: getting a job (alternative path after graduation)
